## What landed

- `exports/record_basis.py` + `web/src/lib/record-basis.ts` — the one `sig.record-basis/1` normalisation of the CONF-07b dedup fields (`site_id`, `copies[]`, `possible_duplicates[]`, `multi_view[]`, `n_independent_lineages`) plus location-check / technology / evidence / checked-by contexts; L3 §5.2 verbatim display strings ride through, absences stay named.
- `<ProvenancePanel>` gains the optional basis block — `panelFromStatement(..., basis)`, `panelForClaim(..., basisIndex)` — rendered identically by every emitter (`ProvenancePanel.tsx`, `claim-panels.tsx`, `provenance_panel.panel_html`) inside the zero-JS `<details>`. Panels on `/r/**` record pages, entity pages, claim viewer, explore and watch-item carry it when the claim's subject is a camera-site record.
- `dossier_sources.py` emits measured `cross_source.colocated_pairs` + a bounded `colocated[]` row list (unique cross-source `possible_duplicates` pairs per dossier) — replacing the `observation_group`-gated `not_evaluable`; `totals.cross_source_colocated_candidates` + the definition text follow.
- The sources explorer renders the measured count + a `<details>` pair list; `/disagreements/` + `/disagreements/place/**` render co-located as the fourth typed kind (hub roll-up + per-place section).
- The count interval lands beside record counts: sources explorer totals, `/dossier/**/sites/` + `/page/<n>/`, `/map/` (`web/map.json` `count_interval`); the dossier page already rendered it.
- The map selection panel carries the basis (fixtures-mode records: the full block; tile props: the interim `st`-derived corroboration wording — never a fabricated value).
- Lexicon `identity.COPY` / `identity.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE` labels wired via `lexiconState`; `data-copy` ids QB-05…QB-08 bound in copy-batch-25.
